name: Orvar
title: Tithekeeper
examine: He walks the sledge out alone every slaughter day and has for thirty years. He is not brave, he says. He is polite, and so are they.
lines: I leave it on the flat stone. I do not wait to watch. That is all the job is.
Not beasts. Neighbors. Neighbors you do not visit.
The stones were here before the bargain. Think on who made it first.
